{"content": "# Q1 2026 Effort Report: p-limit work

**Contributor:** Elif Demir
**Period:** 1 January – 31 March 2026 (Istanbul time, UTC+3)

| Measure | Q1 2026 |
|---|---|
| Commits authored | **5** |
| Active hours | **5.8 h** |

## Method

- **Commits:** commits authored by Elif Demir in the p-limit repository whose author timestamp falls inside the quarter in Istanbul time. Automated dependency-bot commits and commits by other contributors are excluded. A commit made at 01:30 on 1 April (Istanbul) falls in Q2 and is not counted.
- **Active hours:** computed from timestamps in exported Claude Code sessions for the p-limit project. Gaps of more than 30 minutes between consecutive activity are treated as breaks and not counted. Overlapping sessions are merged, so concurrent time is counted once. Activity after 31 March 23:59 Istanbul time is excluded.
- Sessions on other projects, sessions dated outside the quarter, and a duplicate export of one session were left out.

This is self-reported and drawn from local data. Active hours reflect time in Claude Code sessions only and do not include offline work. The report contains no code or prompt content.
